title: London's buried rivers: what still flows in the open, and what runs in the dark
excerpt: I mapped every waterway OpenStreetMap records in Greater London. 228 km of it, about one kilometre in 6, runs in culverts and tunnels, and the Fleet, Tyburn and Westbourne are 97% underground.
seo_description: A map of London's buried rivers: 228 km of culverts under the city, the Fleet, Tyburn and Westbourne, and the rivers lost to the sewers.
header_alt: Title card reading 'London's buried rivers' in black, blue and red on pale paper, beside a map of central London where the Westbourne, Tyburn and Fleet run down to the Thames as red dashed lines glowing gold.
